positions.commentary: Google Plus failed as a product but resulted in a unified company structure and login system.

thesis: The episode argues that Google's Cloud business is significantly behind competitors due to a flawed strategy and lack of focus. It further contends that the company missed the chance to own messaging because it was distracted by Google Plus, which siphoned resources and talent away from critical areas.

claims.claim: Google's Cloud business is significantly behind its competitors due to a wrong strategy and lack of focus.
claims.quote: Google had the wrong strategy in Cloud for many years and as a result, that's why their Cloud business is way behind Amazon and Microsoft.

claims.claim: Google missed the opportunity to own messaging like WhatsApp because it was distracted by Google Plus.
claims.quote: One is messaging. Totally missed messaging. When I was a business school student at Stanford, Eric was now executive chairman and he started co-teaching a class at GSP. I took his class. I was one of his students during these years. It was awesome. It was one of the best classes I ever took.
